$comment: Exhibit image files built by tools/fetch_media.py from the holder's own files. key = file name in site/public/media/ (media id, or <id>-p<page>); page = the holder's image number (MUI-M-0062: image NNNN.jpg of Passport Applications vol. 995, NAID 235846313). NPGallery (MUI-M-0063, MUI-M-0018 to -0021), BRIT/TACC (MUI-M-0064), Wisconsin Historical Society (MUI-M-0034, -0035) and Smithsonian NPG (MUI-M-0042, -0043) files are not listed: tools/fetch_media.py does not accept those hosts yet (see data/inductees/muir/ARTIFACTS.md).
